{{Quote|It's a lie. Fear is a lie. Passion, a lie. Fear gives only temporary powers, and passion is easily manipulated. Real strength in the Force comes when one is no longer afraid.|Kel'eth Ur|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Kel'eth Ur''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who resided on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. By the end of his [[Death/Legends|life]], he taught that passion only led to temporary strength and that true strength was found in peace - a philosophy conventionally associated with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. In [[4606 BBY]], he was killed by the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] for his heresy, according to [[Alaric (Sith)|Alaric]].

He recorded his knowledge in a [[Kel'eth Ur's holocron|holocron]], which was found in the [[Dark Temple]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
